results.name: Restricted principal cannot enter a sell order
results.detail: Real mock sell action rejects the restricted balance.
results.impact: Up to the restricted principal notional if provenance is lost.
results.mitigation: Separate on-chain balance type; transfer hooks and venue allowlists.

results.name: Deposit / withdrawal preserves provenance
results.detail: The actual curve exit returns only restricted CCLX, net of the mock fee.
results.impact: All restricted collateral if an exit reclassifies balances.
results.mitigation: Typed receipts, restricted withdrawal destinations and conservation assertions.

results.name: Restricted rewards cannot become free CCLX
results.detail: Accrued restricted rewards retain their collateral-only type after claim.
results.impact: Reward emissions and legacy principal could become a disguised exit route.
results.mitigation: Separate reward provenance; restricted receipt and claim policies.

results.name: Aggregate and beneficial-owner caps
results.detail: Both cap guards reject claims that would exceed the working limits.
results.impact: Working maximum bridge value $3.3M; not a verified market valuation.
results.mitigation: Snapshot, fixed ratio, consumed entitlements, aggregate and UBO caps.

results.name: Duplicate bridge claim nonce
results.detail: The mock ledger consumes a claim nonce before another claim can use it.
results.impact: Duplicate issuance up to the cap if claims are not atomic.
results.mitigation: Atomic on-chain claim nullifiers, burn/lock proof and replay protection.

results.name: Cliff and allocation-only release
results.detail: No release before cliff; subsequent release unlocks allocation rights, not transfers.
results.mitigation: Immutable vesting logic, audited timestamp math and governance timelocks.

results.name: Receipt transfer, wrapper and pledge isolation
results.detail: All three actual mock paths reject restricted receipts.
results.impact: Full pledged amount and potential borrowed cash.
results.mitigation: Non-transferable receipt contract; reject approvals, permits and composable wrappers.

results.name: Restricted collateral cannot be borrowed against
results.detail: Borrowing stays prohibited even if the ordinary borrowing feature is enabled.
results.impact: Borrowed quote currency can bypass principal transfer restrictions.
results.mitigation: Hard prohibition on restricted collateral in all lending adapters and liquidations.

results.name: Curve reserve and round-trip invariants
results.detail: Buy/mint and redeem/burn preserve reserve backing; fees remain separate.
results.impact: Unfunded redemption obligations or artificial collateral creation.
results.mitigation: Reserve conservation, audited arithmetic and explicit funding of parameter changes.

results.name: Milestone cannot mint an unfunded floor
results.detail: Raising the curve intercept without additional backing is rejected.
results.impact: Artificial NAV or implied redemption floor.
results.mitigation: Require independent milestone validation and explicit reserve funding.

results.name: Large selling consumes finite market liquidity
results.detail: 10M CCLX sell receives $1350029; DEX quote reserve remains $149071.
results.impact: Severe impact and possible near-exhaustion of executable quote liquidity.
results.mitigation: Slippage guards, finite cash budgets, auction/OTC paths and circuit breakers.

results.name: Legacy and unissued rewards excluded from sellable unlocks
results.detail: Restricted releases and unissued reward ceilings have no automatic sellable-flow contribution.
results.impact: Overstated liquidity or incorrectly assumed circulating supply.
results.mitigation: Separate issued / circulating / restricted / governed / unissued ledgers.

results.name: Emission ceiling is enforced
results.detail: Extremely high reward demand is scaled down to the monthly budget.
results.impact: Excess minting or an unfunded advertised APR.
results.mitigation: Capped emissions, per-epoch accounting and no promised fixed APR.

results.name: Rewards cannot be claimed twice
results.detail: Second claim has no effect on already consumed reward balances.
results.mitigation: Atomic claim accounting and claim-event reconciliation.

results.name: Borrowing LTV and oracle-deviation controls
results.detail: The mock debt path rejects a loan above the conservative collateral LTV. Live oracle validation remains separate.
results.impact: Overvalued collateral multiplied by borrowing LTV.
results.mitigation: Independent oracle feeds, staleness/deviation guards, TWAP and conservative LTV.

results.name: Beneficial-owner / Sybil identity linkage
results.detail: No connected KYC/UBO provider. The mock owner ID cannot establish that two wallets share a beneficial owner.
results.impact: Per-entity cap may be bypassed using linked identities.
results.mitigation: Identity verification, UBO aggregation, sanctions screening and claim review.

results.name: Smart-contract reentrancy and ERC-1155 hooks
results.detail: No Solidity contracts or deployed bytecode exist in this lab. JavaScript state tests cannot establish EVM safety.
results.impact: Collateral theft, double withdrawals or unauthorized transfers.
results.mitigation: Contract-level invariant/fuzz tests, formal review and independent audit.

results.name: Live oracle manipulation and staleness
results.detail: No production oracle adapters, reference market feeds or on-chain TWAP implementation connected.
results.mitigation: Multi-source oracle, circuit breakers, heartbeat and deviation checks.

results.name: Flash-loan / same-block staking manipulation
results.detail: No blockchain execution layer. Time-weighted rewards are a proposed mitigation, not an audited contract implementation.
results.impact: Up to an unguarded reward epoch or collateral manipulation exposure.
results.mitigation: Time-weighted balances, minimum hold, cooldown and same-block restrictions.

sandwich.warning: Synthetic same-snapshot round trip; ignores gas, MEV competition, external price movement and venue execution constraints.
